v2_origin.extracted_from: regularize-replay.js parity baseline + R.0/R.0b/R.1 cost terms; v3 evolved beyond v2 with the make-shared cascade (T0..T8 + L1) in 2026-06

summary: DOF-aware corner-position optimiser over the roof-graph. Tags each corner's degrees of freedom from path topology + ridge incidence (R.0), reconciles plane-membership down to path-membership (R.0b), then runs a coordinate-descent loop (R.1) over corner positions minimising a weighted sum of cost terms: WSD (Wasserstein support distance to LiDAR), angle priors, neighbour-angle priors, horizontal-edge priors, joint two-corner moves, plus three coplanarity costs (horizontal/vertical/collinear). After each accepted move, runs CHASE_AFTER_MOVE: MERGE_CORNER cross-plane weld (T5) → DROP_REDUNDANT_ON_RIDGE (T6) → SPLIT_TO_SHARE_CORNER (T7) → R.2 proximity merge → R.3 collinear removal → snap-in (T4). Post-loop: L1 orphan-kill, then re-emit polygon_paths + EDGES from final polys[]. Replaces the separate v7-boundary-merge step (Path B, 2026-06-12).

phases.name: Topological DOF tag + ridge index
phases.description: Build cs[].ridge_ids from corners_in[].ridge_ids ∩ rg[] clipped segments at τ_in=ridge_merge_coplanar_m. Build plane→ridges CSR index. Tag each corner's DOF from path membership (planes_of(ci) = path-scan) AND ridge incidence (DOF coupling, BR_DOF_COUPLE): dof = min(plane_dof, ridge_dof); a single-plane on-ridge corner gets DOF-1 with axis = ridge.rd.

phases.name: Plane membership reconciliation (Phase B SSoT)
phases.description: polygon paths are the single source of truth for per-corner plane membership. planes_dyn is computed on demand from path-scan (was a stored field, deleted in v10). R.0 DOF is TOPOLOGICAL not geometric — fixes spurious over-locks where corners coplanar with a far plane were mis-tagged junctions. PRE-LOOP DROP_REDUNDANT_ON_RIDGE sweeps the all-polys-agree midpoint cleanup ONCE before any corner motion.

phases.name: Coordinate-descent loop with CHASE_AFTER_MOVE
phases.description: For each non-frozen corner, sample nudge offsets in [-nudge_range_m, +nudge_range_m] at nudge_step_m granularity along its DOF axes. Evaluate cost = Σ λ_i · term_i (WSD + angle + neighbour-angle + horizontal-edge + horiz/vert/collinear coplanarity). Acceptance: r1_acceptance_strategy=GLOBAL_BEST (matches v2). After accept, CHASE_AFTER_MOVE: MERGE_CORNER (T5 cross-plane weld via v7p_solve_member_position + M5 self-int reject via v7_local_edges_cross_uv) → DROP_REDUNDANT_ON_RIDGE (T6, in-loop) → SPLIT_TO_SHARE_CORNER (T7, the only growing op) → R.2 proximity merge → R.3 collinear removal → snap-in (T4). Optionally interleave joint two-corner moves (use_joint_moves). Terminate at max_iterations OR no-accept iteration.

phases.name: Make-shared cascade (T4..T8 + L1)
phases.description: FIVE named ops on shared corners (all wired inside CHASE_AFTER_MOVE except orphan-kill which is post-loop). T4 SNAP_IN (one-way, idempotent) + read-only M1 guard preview. T5 MERGE_CORNER (cross-plane weld with type-gate {ridge,hip,valley}, position via constraint-aware solver, M5 self-int reject). T6 DROP_REDUNDANT_ON_RIDGE (all-polys-agree midpoint cleanup, pre-loop + in-loop). T7 SPLIT_TO_SHARE_CORNER (a single-plane DOF-1 corner cA on an allow-listed ridge R lies on a B-plane edge whose both endpoints carry ridge_id R → cA's id is inserted into polys[B]; cA does NOT move; growing op, gated by BR_NO_SPLIT). T8 close-out + SETTLE cascade. L1 orphan-kill (post-loop): mark dead any still-alive corner in no live polygon path.

phases.name: Re-emit roof-graph + DOF + movements
phases.description: Re-emit polygon_paths + EDGES from final polys[] (was a pre-loop snapshot pre-v4 — missing in-loop R.2/R.3/R.4 edits caused dead-id refs). DOF records emit only alive corners (post L1 orphan-kill). Movements record per-corner pre/post position + Δ. The downstream classify step picks up the new EDGES for INTERIOR_SHARED classification.

parameters.name: maxIterations
parameters.summary: Outer R.1 loop cap. Default lowered from 1000 → 200 (2026-05-30) — ablation on dahouet-bldgonly showed 90% of cost-improvement at iter ~19; cap=200 finishes at <2% worse cost than cap=1000 for 5× less wall time. See v3/docs/plan/BOUNDARY-REGULARIZE-PROFILE-PLAN.md.

parameters.name: nudgeRangeM
parameters.summary: Per-corner nudge offset range [-range, +range] along each DOF axis.

parameters.name: nudgeStepM
parameters.summary: Nudge sampling granularity. nudgeRange/nudgeStep = nudge samples per axis (default 10).

parameters.name: angleSnapThreshDeg
parameters.summary: Polygon-angle snap window for canonical-angle costs.

parameters.name: useAngleCost
parameters.summary: Enable canonical-angle cost (polygon angles snap to {45,90,135,180}, or +{30,60,120,150} if useExtendedAngles).

parameters.name: useHorizontalEdgeCost
parameters.summary: Enable cost favouring horizontal eaves / ridges.

parameters.name: useTrustWeighting
parameters.summary: Per-WSD-point trust weight from upstream point-plane residual buffer.

parameters.name: useProximityMerge
parameters.summary: R.2 in-CHASE: merge two corners within proximityMergeDistM.

parameters.name: useCollinearRemoval
parameters.summary: R.3 in-CHASE: drop single-plane corners with polygon angle within collinearRemovalThresholdDeg of 180°.

parameters.name: useRidgeMerge
parameters.summary: T5/T6/T7 make-shared cascade enable (BR_NO_R4=0 default ON; SPLIT step is independently gated by BR_NO_SPLIT, default OFF).

parameters.name: ridgeMergeDistM
parameters.summary: T5 MERGE_CORNER cross-plane weld threshold. 0.50 m matches dahouet's clean on-crease corner pairs (~0.4 m apart). See R.4 audit 2026-06-12.

parameters.name: ridgeMergeCoplanarM
parameters.summary: τ_in for ridge_ids reality-intersect + snap-in incidence test.

parameters.name: jointSamplesPerEdge
parameters.summary: Joint-move sample count per polygon edge.

parameters.name: upAxis
parameters.summary: 1 = y-up (impl is hardcoded y-up; the step wrapper applies the z-up↔y-up swap).

writes.name: boundary-regularize-roof-graph
writes.summary: Per-bldg TLV: PLANES + CORNERS (post-MERGE/L1) + EDGES + POLYGON_PATHS (re-emitted from final polys[]) + PERIMETER_TAGS overlay + ridge stats.

envvars.name: BR_NO_R4
envvars.summary: Legacy R.4 crude make-shared (now: T5 MERGE_CORNER + T6 DROP + snap-in / guard preview). Env unset → feature ON. Set BR_NO_R4=1 (any value) to disable for A/B.

envvars.name: BR_NO_SPLIT
envvars.summary: T7 SPLIT_TO_SHARE_CORNER. Env unset → SPLIT ON (the growing op fires). Set BR_NO_SPLIT=1 to disable for A/B.

envvars.name: BR_SNAP_IN
envvars.summary: T4 in-loop snap-in. Default ON. Set BR_SNAP_IN=0 to suppress the FREE→RIDGE tag-write inside CHASE — loop output then byte-identical to pre-T4.

envvars.name: BR_DOF_COUPLE
envvars.summary: R.0 DOF coupling (min-DOF, ridge-axis on single-plane on-ridge corners). Set BR_DOF_COUPLE=0 to disable.

envvars.name: BR_PROFILE
envvars.summary: Per-phase wall-time + metric counters → stderr summary at end of compute. Env present (any value) → profiling ON. ~30 ns per clock_gettime, negligible vs the work.

envvars.name: BR_CHECK
envvars.summary: Consistency gate — dead-id / edges⇔paths invariant. Recommended ON during dev (= the green-invariant signal). See brief from Stream B Quality Agent.

envvars.name: BR_TEST_RESERVE_FAIL
envvars.summary: Test-only OOM injection — forces poly_reserve / ctx_reserve to be treated as failed so SPLIT REJECTs cleanly (fixture E).
